title: Home beer dispenser
description: a home beer dispenser designed to dispense bottled beer using a hand-operated valve and compressed carbon dioxide
reference_excerpt: The product in question is a home beer dispenser, specifically designed for dispensing bottled beer. It operates using a hand-operated valve that introduces compressed carbon dioxide (CO2) into the beer bottle, pressurizing it to control the flow of beer. The dispenser is made from various plastic components. According to the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), the applicable subheading for this type of product falls under 8481.80.5090, which covers "other taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances, hand operated, of other materials." classification.rationale: The good is a hand-operated dispensing valve system driven by compressed CO2. Heading 8481 covers hand-operated appliances of that kind, and N334601 (in force) treated a CO2 draft system as heading 8481 because the tap gives it essential character. The material is not given, so I assumed the 'other materials' line, 8481.80.50.90. If the valve is steel, 8481.80.30.90 would apply instead.
